label: INFORMATION AUDIT on one family. Not a product proposal. All BabySlakh tracks are CONSUMED. Nothing promotable. No visual test.
the_only_question: Does the identical 53-dimensional causal feature set contain usable information for synth_lead_pad when cross-family shortcut learning is removed?

WHAT_IS_NOT_YET_ACCEPTED.the_over_strong_claim: THE 53 CAUSAL FEATURES DO NOT CONTAIN THE SYNTH/PAD DISTINCTION
WHAT_IS_NOT_YET_ACCEPTED.who_raised_it: the analyst, in the J3Q handover. The PM rejected it as one inference too far, and the analyst accepts that.
why_it_was_unsupported: J3Q balanced POSITIVE versus NEGATIVE classes but did NOT equalise instrument-family contribution. The pooled learner saw far more harmonic events from piano and bass than from synth, and onset evidence is extremely useful on those dominant families, so an onset-heavy policy is what the pooled loss rewards.
permutation importance establishes what THIS TRAINED MODEL USED. It cannot establish what the features CONTAIN under a different conditional mapping.

the strongest warning came from the J3Q synth result itself: permuting the C3-state blocks IMPROVED synth separation (0.0350 -> 0.0805). That proves the pooled model learned a HARMFUL USE of those features on pads. It does not prove those features carry no pad information.

why_the_distinction_is_load_bearing.if_synth_only_training_works: J3Q exposed NEGATIVE TRANSFER / SHORTCUT LEARNING, and the next architectural problem is domain routing or multi-domain policy learning
why_the_distinction_is_load_bearing.if_it_still_fails: the feature-limit reading becomes a strong conclusion and the learned-reliability lane closes on this feature set

the_one_change.J3Q: training rows = all five measured families

DISCLOSED_CONSEQUENCE_OF_HOLDING_THE_REC.the_fact: batch size 4096 and 30 epochs are held fixed as instructed, so the number of Adam steps falls with the training set. Pooled J3Q trained on roughly 25,000 rows per fold (about 7 batches per epoch, ~210 steps). Synth-only folds hold roughly 3,000 to 5,200 rows (1 to 2 batches per epoch, 30 to 60 steps).
DISCLOSED_CONSEQUENCE_OF_HOLDING_THE_REC.why_it_is_not_corrected: the brief is explicit that batch size and epoch count are unchanged. Holding the recipe fixed and holding the optimisation-step count fixed are in direct conflict; the brief chose the recipe. Changing either would break the single-variable design.
DISCLOSED_CONSEQUENCE_OF_HOLDING_THE_REC.how_it_will_be_handled: steps per epoch, total steps, and the first-epoch and final-epoch mean training loss are REPORTED PER FOLD. If the synth-only arm fails while its training loss has barely moved, that is evidence of UNDER-TRAINING rather than absent information, and the SYNTH_FEATURE_LIMIT_SUPPORTED reading must be qualified accordingly.

FOLDS_REUSED_FROM_J3Q_EXACTLY.rule: the same deterministic five track folds as J3Q - np.array_split(default_rng(20260902).permutation(sorted unique tracks over ALL FIVE measured families), 5)
FOLDS_REUSED_FROM_J3Q_EXACTLY.critical_detail: the track list is derived from ALL FIVE families' rows, exactly as J3Q did, NOT from synth stems alone. Deriving it from synth tracks would change the permutation and therefore the folds.
per_fold: train only on synth_lead_pad stems belonging to TRAINING tracks
predict only on synth_lead_pad stems belonging to HELD-OUT tracks

SUPERVISION.NEGATIVE: oracle movement rank <= 0.50 AND C3 movement rank >= 0.80
SUPERVISION.AMBIGUOUS: excluded from the loss, never silently labelled negative
SUPERVISION.loss: the same balanced binary cross entropy
SUPERVISION.note: because only synth_lead_pad rows enter training, equal positive/negative weighting now operates WITHIN the actual problematic domain
SUPERVISION.no_family_weights_invented: there is only one family in this audit

J3Q_not_retrained_as_a_new_experiment: the pooled arm is reproduced with the exact committed recipe and the same folds and seed inside the same run, so both arms are scored on identical frames. A control asserts the reproduced pooled synth metrics match the committed J3Q_RESULT.json.
PRIMARY_METRICS_synth_lead_pad_only: q at STABLE and C3-high frames

RECALL_GUARD.rule: synth-only gated movement may not lose more than 0.02 event-tolerant recall versus raw C3

requires_both: the synth-only OOF policy reduces synth_lead_pad false movement below C3
it satisfies the existing 0.02 recall guard
SYNTH_FEATURE_SIGNAL_PRESENT.interpretation: the J3Q failure was NOT evidence that the 53 features lack synth/pad information. At least some useful information is present once cross-family negative transfer is removed.
SYNTH_FEATURE_SIGNAL_PRESENT.what_it_means_next: the next architectural problem is context/domain routing or multi-domain policy learning. STOP. Do not solve that automatically.

SYNTH_FEATURE_LIMIT_SUPPORTED.requires: all machinery controls pass AND the synth-only OOF policy fails to reduce false movement OR violates the recall guard
SYNTH_FEATURE_LIMIT_SUPPORTED.interpretation: even with onset-bearing families removed from training, the frozen 53-feature causal representation cannot produce the required synth/pad restraint with the already-tested tiny nonlinear policy
SYNTH_FEATURE_LIMIT_SUPPORTED.consequence: CLOSE the learned-reliability lane on this feature set. Do NOT try a larger network on the same inputs. Any future revisit must introduce genuinely new evidence - longer causal temporal shape, richer spectral-envelope structure, or another independently justified causal descriptor - and NONE of those is executed in J3R.
SYNTH_FEATURE_LIMIT_SUPPORTED.qualification_that_must_travel_with_it: if the fold training losses show the synth-only arm barely moved, the conclusion is weakened to 'not learnable by this recipe at this training size' and must be reported that way

triggered_by_only: insufficient synth tracks or only one supervision class in a contributing fold
SYNTH_REPRESENTABILITY_INCONCLUSIVE.operationalisation: a contributing fold is INSUFFICIENT if it has zero training synth stems or only one supervision class present. No new numeric sufficiency threshold is invented; the per-fold counts are reported so the PM can judge.

BLOCK_IMPORTANCE.rule: do NOT repeat the feature-importance zoo unless SYNTH_FEATURE_SIGNAL_PRESENT
BLOCK_IMPORTANCE.if_signal: exactly one reported synth-only block-permutation diagnostic, to identify what changed versus J3Q

NO_VISUAL_TEST.reason: J3R is an information audit on ONE family and cannot supply a general mixture policy. A positive result merely says the feature information exists.

CONTROLS_THAT_MUST_PASS: folds are byte-identical to the J3Q folds (asserted against the same seeded permutation of the same all-family track list)
no synth stem appears in the training set of the fold that holds out its track
standardisation fitted on training rows only, separately per arm
oracle labels absent from the feature matrix
every scored synth frame has an OOF prediction from both arms
both q outputs finite and in [0,1]
the reproduced pooled synth metrics match the committed J3Q_RESULT.json

PRESERVED_UNCHANGED_AND_NOT_MUTATED.J3Q: LEARNED_RESTRAINT_FAIL - J3R does not revisit or soften that outcome
PRESERVED_UNCHANGED_AND_NOT_MUTATED.target: the rectangular MIDI duration-occupancy oracle, unmodified

DO_NOT_EXECUTE: any mutation of any historical receipt
then_stop: return to the PM after exactly one outcome.
